events.name: The Sunlit Welcoming
events.description: An intimate daytime gathering amid fragrant citrus groves, sunlit stone arches, and golden harps to welcome esteemed dignitaries.

events.name: The Twilight Conservatory Gala
events.description: An enchanted evening of floral botanical art, sitar and cellos, and delicate henna artistry under glass domed ceilings.

events.name: The Sacred Solemnisation
events.description: The sacred exchange of royal vows and blessings beneath monumental ivory marble vaults adorned with white hydrangeas.
events.dress: Formal Imperial Black Tie / Royal Sherwani

events.name: The Grand Burgundy Ball
events.description: A magnificent royal banquet with crystal chandeliers, grand waltzes, ceremonial toasts, and midnight fireworks over the lake.

ourStory.title: A Serendipitous Encounter
ourStory.description: Introduced in the quiet archives of the Royal Library in Florence, bonded by a shared love for classical art, architecture, and timeless literature.

ourStory.title: Starlit Promises in Seville
ourStory.description: Beneath the illuminated arches of the Alcázar courtyards, quiet admiration blossomed into an unbreakable promise of lifelong devotion.

ourStory.title: The Imperial Betrothal
ourStory.description: At twilight on the shores of Lake Como, with family blessing and heirloom diamond seal, a sacred question was asked and answered.
